spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use 'Bento Tetris' for portfolio, and wide asymmetrical CSS Grid for Services. Emphasize generous spacing (3x scale) to let the high-contrast elements breathe.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangles, no border-radius. bg-accent text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)] transition-all duration-300.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. bg-surface_elevated border border-white/5. Hover state: border-accent/50 with subtle internal glow. No heavy shadows, just clean borders.
components.glassmorphism: Used strictly for floating nav and chat widget. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10.

motion_and_interactions.entrance: Framer motion staggered fade-up for texts. Image reveals with scale down from 1.1 to 1.0.
motion_and_interactions.hover: High contrast shift, accent color reveal, magnetic button effects.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.instructions: Sticky floating nav, glassmorphism, logo on left, links center, 'START A PROJECT' CTA on right. Use JetBrains Mono for links.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.instructions: Shock and awe. Massive typography (Cabinet Grotesk) reading 'DOMINATE THE DIGITAL NOISE'. Asymmetric layout. Background image overlaid with black/60 + noise texture. Include a kinetic marquee (react-fast-marquee) reading 'WEB DESIGN - SEO - PAID ADS' at the bottom. Use 'data-testid="hero-cta"' for the main button.

sections.name: Stats / Social Proof
sections.instructions: A sleek horizontal bar beneath the hero. Big numbers (e.g., '$100M+ Generated', '150+ Brands Scaled'). JetBrains Mono for numbers, Satoshi for descriptors.

sections.name: Services Showcase
sections.instructions: 5 Cards. Use 'Control Room' grid. Web Dev, SEO, Paid Ads, Social Media, Branding. Cards should have a hover effect that reveals an accent border. Include an icon (lucide-react) and a short punchy description.

sections.name: Process / How We Work
sections.instructions: Vertical timeline or a 3-step asymmetric bento layout. 1. Audit, 2. Execute, 3. Dominate. Use huge typography for numbers (01, 02, 03) with text stroke (transparent fill, white border).

sections.name: Portfolio / Case Studies
sections.instructions: Grid-based 'Tetris' Layout. Showcase 3-4 projects. Large images. On hover, show overlay with ROAS/Conversion metrics. Use 'data-testid="portfolio-item"' on each card.

sections.name: Pricing Packages
sections.instructions: 3 tiers (Ignite, Accelerate, Dominate). Central tier ('Accelerate') highlighted with accent border and 'MOST POPULAR' label. List features using Shadcn Icons. Sharp UI.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.instructions: Minimalist carousel. High-end fashion portrait style images for clients. Quote in large italics, client name and company below.

sections.name: Blog / Insights Teaser
sections.instructions: List view or 3-column grid of recent articles. Focus on typography. Overline dates.

sections.name: Footer
sections.instructions: Massive typography 'READY TO SCALE?' Dark footer, contrasting the section above. Big email link, social links, copyright.

sections.name: Floating Elements
sections.instructions: 1. AI Assistant Chat Widget (bottom right) with glowing accent dot. 2. Inquiry Modal (Triggered by CTA buttons, Shadcn Dialog, form with Name, Email, Company, Service, Budget, Message).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis is installed (yarn add @studio-freight/lenis) and wrapping the app for smooth momentum scrolling.
Use framer-motion for staggering text reveals and image scale-ins. No raw CSS transitions for major layout entry.
Do not use Shadcn card components for the creative sections; construct flat geometric divs with borders manually for ultimate control.
The inquiry form should be built with Shadcn dialog and form components, visually stripped back to match the dark aesthetic (border-white/10).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements as per the testing rules.
Ensure contrast passes APCA standards; text on dark background must be white or white/70.
The accent color (#CCFF00) should be used sparingly for maximum impact (hover states, key buttons, glowing dots).
Load fonts from the provided CDNs in the HTML head or global CSS.
Never use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
